thread:
Rowan: quick sync — prepping launch week collateral. need 3 micro-claims for battlecard + 1-line customer-ready rebut per claim. target: infra/platform buyers and SEs. keep them scannable.

Zoe: propose micro-claims: 1) predictable unit economics for steady monthly spend; 2) engineered tail resilience with automated fallbacks; 3) one runtime that migrates from POC to private deployment.

Ibrahim: like that. for each rebut let's keep practical scripts SEs can say in 1 sentence. examples: 
- Econ rebut: 'We stabilize per-request variability so finance can forecast without overprovisioning GPUs.' 
- Tail rebut: 'Built-in fallbacks (quantized/regional) keep UX responsive when demand spikes.' 
- Runtime rebut: 'Same API and controls across hosted,dedicated,private — minimal app changes when scaling.'

Cam: benchmark slide guidance — avoid brand brawls. show p50/p95/p99 latency + cost per 1M tokens, and a 1-line methodology. aim for a single small chart and a short caption.

Zoe: tagline A/B to test on social: A) 'Predictable inference spend. Production-ready performance.' B) 'One API. Any deployment. Production confidence.'

Ibrahim: ops/legal note: no absolutes like 'cheaper' or 'always'. use comparative phrasing: 'lower unit cost in common production patterns'. Also ops wants a short failure-flow: primary model -> smaller quantized variant -> regional fallback -> queued rapid retries. we'll keep it to a single slide.

Rowan: I added a quick battlecard micro-script for objection handling: 
- "We own infra": 'Great — when you want to focus on product, we reduce the daily ops burden and make costs predictable while keeping control.' 
- "API is enough": 'We keep the simple API surface but add monitoring, rollout controls and private placements for compliance.' 

Cam: one-line methodology blurb for the slide: `Method: 9k anonymized prompts, median 105 tokens. Measured p50/p95/p99 latency and normalized token cost across two deployment modes.`

ops-bot: created page: https://notion.redwood/competitive/gotm-econ-hooks (v1) :white_check_mark:

Zoe: action items: Zoe — draft two headline variants + 90s webinar opener (today); Ibrahim — run 48h SE poll for micro-scripts + collect live rebut examples (48h); Cam — produce chart mock + one-line caption (tomorrow); Rowan — assemble battlecard one-pager + failure-flow slide (tomorrow).

Ibrahim: I'll ping with poll results and drop any customer soundbites here. putting a placeholder quote: 'Dedicated made inference spend predictable enough to plan feature rollouts.'

Rowan: tidy. let's keep copy testable and avoid hyperbole. ship the draft after Ibrahim's SE signals and Cam's chart. :rocket:
